name: Speech-Language Pathology, MS—Connect (Boston)
disclaimer: NU Map is an independent, student-built planner. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially connected to Northeastern University. Data is scraped from Northeastern's public catalog and refreshed on a schedule; always confirm with the official catalog and an academic advisor.

legend.notes: Sentences quoted verbatim from the catalog page that state a condition we could NOT express as structure — exclusions ("Research courses may not be used"), eligibility lists, per-course grade minimums. A section can consist of nothing but these. Quote them; never infer from them that a particular course does or does not satisfy the section.
legend.creditsRequired: Semester hours the catalog states for a section whose courses it does not list. Do not add these into a program total: some restate credit that another section already counts.

notes: Complete one of the following, as determined by the faculty advisor:

requirementSections.title: Electives
notes: Complete 3 semester hours of coursework from the options below.
Students who have previously completed SLPA 5107 (or equivalent, as determined by the faculty advisor) should complete Option B below.
All other students must complete Option A below.

requirementSections.title: Option B
notes: Other courses may be chosen with preapproval of the student's faculty advisor.

requirementSections.title: Optional Thesis
notes: Complete 3 semester hours across two semesters with prior approval.

gpaRequirements.title: Program Credit/GPA Requirements
gpaRequirements.text: 69-75 total semester hours required (78 with optional thesis) Minimum 3.000 GPA required

footnotes.text: Students who are assessed not to require Aural Rehabilitation (SLPA 6219) will choose an additional 3 semester hours of electives (below), for a total of 6 semester hours of electives for degree completion.
